launch_method_after_second_interruption: the orchestrator is now started with subprocess start_new_session=True, so it runs in its own session and process group (verified PPID 1, PGID = its own pid) and is not reachable by signals aimed at the shell's process group, which is what ended the first two attempts
protocol_elements_changed: none — arms, seeds, starts, scales, cadence, gate function, burn-in, thinning, ceiling and stopping rule are the frozen runner's own objects
why_the_ladder_is_not_re_entered_at_the_: re-running an already-evaluated rung would recompute its gate over the draws retained since, and overwrite the recorded result; the registered history is preserved instead
